IS 1537 : 1976 Vertically cast iron pressure pipes for water, gas and sewageUDC 621.643.2.986 [669.13-141]MTD 6Reaffirmed 20141 Scope1.1 This standard covers the requirements for cast iron pipesfor pressure main lines of water, gas and sewage manufactured byvertical castings in sand moulds.1.2 This standard is applicable to pipes with sockets (for leadjoints) or flngers. The standard may also be made applicable toother types of joints specially rubber joints, where overallmeasurements shall be adhered to, to ensure interchangeability.2 ReferencesIS 2 :1960Rules for rounding offnumerical valuesIS 210 : 1970Specification for grey iron castingsIS 1387 : 1967General requirements for the supply of metallurgical materialsIS 1536 : 1976Specification for centrifugally cast (spun) iron pressurepipes for water, gas and sewageIS 1789 : 1961Methodfor Brinell hardness test for grey cast ironIS 2078 : 1962Methodfor tensile testing of grey cast ironIS 7184 : 1974Specification for horizontally cast iron double flangedpipes for water, gas and sewage
